{"edits": [], "notes": "No edits proposed for resources/errors.py.

- The only finding (resources/errors.py:13, optional-no-default) is already fixed in the current content. The `Message` model reads `message: Optional[str] = None`, so the v1 default of None is preserved in v2. Adding another `= None` would be a no-op.
- `ErrorResponse` subclasses `Exception`, not a Pydantic model, so it needs no v2 changes.
- No deprecated v1 APIs (`@validator`, `@root_validator`, `class Config`, `.dict()`/`.json()`, `parse_obj`, etc.) appear in this file.
- The reported failure, `test_teams_client_no_connection_proxy`, is a Keycloak connection refusal on localhost:35789 from urllib3. It is an environment or test-fixture problem (no Keycloak server is listening), not a Pydantic problem. Nothing in this file can fix it. Test-side setup or the proxy configuration would need to be checked separately."}
